items.evidence: From cold (examen tools said no_engine), ran `python tools/kit.py build` in work/: in 8 s it printed a JSON list of gear/heart/star/coin, each with name, triangles (320/5588/36/768), closed true and x/y/z bounds. It started a windowless engine and stopped it again (no_engine afterwards).
`python tools/kit.py frames` rewrote frames/gear.png, heart.png, star.png and coin.png. All four PNG headers say 512x512. I looked at each: the whole prop is in view, with a margin all round.

frames/gear.png shows 12 identical teeth, evenly spaced, and a round central hole with the background showing through it. My own oblique frame (judge-scratch/gear_oblique.png) shows the hole goes right through the 0.05 slab.
Build output for the gear: x -0.15..0.15 (0.300), y 1.8e-6..0.29999 (0.300, stands on y=0), z -0.025..0.025 (0.050). All within 0.1% of the asked sizes.

frames/heart.png reads as a heart: two round lobes on top and a point at the bottom. My oblique and side frames show a lens/pillow cross-section with no sharp outer edge. Bounds are 0.300 wide and 0.050 thick.
frames/star.png shows a five-pointed star with sharp tips, evenly spaced, one point up. Bounds: x 0.29996 across tip to tip (0.285 tall), z 0.050 thick, y min about 0.

Bounds are x 0.200, z 0.020 (a disc 0.2 across). The lathe profile has a 0.0145 field inside a 0.02 rim (r 0.085-0.1). My front-oblique (judge-scratch/coin_oblique.png) and back-oblique (coin_back.png) frames both show the raised rim ring around a recessed middle. The rim is only 3 mm proud, and the README front frame does not show it.

The build reports closed: true for all four recipes. All four use the one shared assets/style.json (materials metal/painted, palette steel/rose/gold): flat upright 2-5 cm tokens on y=0 in front light, so they read as one set.

README gives `python tools/kit.py build` and `python tools/kit.py frames`, to be run from work/. Both worked exactly as written with no engine running at the start, and each stopped the engine it started.

defects: Heart sides (seen from the side, judge-scratch/heart_side.png) have a ragged, jagged seam from the sculpt grid, and a faint centre crease shows in the front frame. It has 5588 triangles, which is heavy for a pickup.
style.json says every prop has 'a small soft edge so it catches light', but the gear, star and coin have hard, unbevelled edges. The heart alone is soft.
The gear renders dark grey in its front frame (steel metal in front light), so it reads duller than the other three.
The coin's rim is only 3 mm proud and cannot be seen in the README's front frame. Only a view at an angle shows it.
The frame and build commands hard-code the examen path and the run folder of this machine (EXAMEN/KIT_RUN can override them).
